reactor_type: Pulsar 2000 ALCVD reactor attached to an ASM P8200 polygon cluster tool
evidence: The investigated samples consist of ZrO2 and Al2O3 films deposited by ALCVD in a Pulsar 2000 ALCVD reactor attached to an ASM P8200 polygon cluster tool, using alternating surface saturating reactions between ZrCl4 (or Al(CH3)3) and H2O at 300/C176C.
